name: yonkoma
title: Yonkoma
description: A four-panel strip read top to bottom, to explain something in four beats, built on the page model: a free-height Page (format strip) with one Tier per panel, or one Tier of four panels in a row in the manga reading order. The API is four children, one per panel, plus an optional title box; each panel is a named group for screen readers with a small number box in its corner. A child given as a fragment is spread into its panel, so Place elements in it (bubbles with pointAt, captions, Sfx) sit on the page and may cross the frame. The strip measures itself: frames stay about 3px and the lettering stays readable at any width. orientation="horizontal" puts the four in a row; "auto" stacks them, then lines them up once the strip is 40rem wide. Any aspect ratio per panel.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/yonkoma". Each child fills its panel: position your art inside it, or pass a fragment whose Place elements (from "@/components/manga/panel") put bubbles, captions and sound effects on the panel. Pass labels so each panel has a spoken description.

meta.tagline: Four panels, top to bottom, to tell it in four beats.
meta.usage:
import { Place } from "@/components/manga/panel"
import { SpeechBubble } from "@/components/manga/speech-bubble"
import { Yonkoma } from "@/components/manga/yonkoma"

<Yonkoma title="How it works" labels={["Install", "Import", "Style", "Ship"]}>
  <StepOne />
  <StepTwo />
  <StepThree />
  <>
    <StepFour />
    <Place x={70} y={10}>
      <SpeechBubble pointAt={{ x: "50%", y: "70%" }}>Shipped!</SpeechBubble>
    </Place>
  </>
</Yonkoma>

props.name: children
props.description: Four children, one per panel. Extra ones are left out.

props.name: numbered
props.description: Number box in each panel's corner.

props.name: labels
props.description: Spoken description of each panel (default "Panel 1 of 4"…).

props.name: orientation
props.description: A column, a row in the reading order, or a column that becomes a row from 40rem.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Width / height of each panel, as a number or a CSS ratio.
